summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_11 blockers + full RevenueCat purchase chain in the web preview. BOTH BLOCKERS FIXED and full end-to-end purchase chain verified. (1) paywall-buy-button now reads 'Go ad-free — $2.99/month' — confirmed via inner_text after full boot on /paywall. (2) identityReady is TRUE: aria-disabled=None on paywall-buy-button, 'Syncing your account…' warning gone; '[RevenueCat] identity bound: ui-test-user' log fires after Purchases.logIn in _layout.tsx and the react-query cache is now seeded via queryClient.setQueryData + invalidateQueries. (3) Full purchase chain PASSED: paywall-buy-button → paywall-confirm-modal ('Start PRO? $2.99/month…') → paywall-confirm-button opened the RC Test Store overlay ('Test Store Purchase / Product: pro.monthly / Price: $2.99') → 'Test valid purchase' completed the test-store transaction. Post-purchase verified: manage-pro-button in Profile>cog sheet reads 'PRO' (was 'Upgrade'), Friends leaderboard shows the golden testID leaderboard-pro-badge on the ui-test-user OWN row only (Ferny row has no badge), and reopening /paywall via Profile>cog>manage-pro-button now renders paywall-active card ('You're PRO 🎉'). (4) paywall-restore-button ran without crashing (no paywall-error, paywall-screen stayed mounted). (5) paywall-close correctly returned to /profile when opened via router.push (Profile>cog>Upgrade flow). Regression PASSED: NO 'RevenueCat public API keys not found' error in console; all 5 tabs (Tree/Goals/Focus/Friends/Profile) render; RC SDK initialized in Browser Mode with test key. ONE MINOR (non-blocking) observation: right after 'Test valid purchase' completes, the paywall screen does not immediately swap the buy button for the paywall-active card (customerInfoUpdateListener does not fire on web SDK after purchase); the entitlement IS applied server-side (visible on Profile 'PRO' label + Friends golden badge) and paywall-active DOES render on the next mount of /paywall. Consider invalidating ['revenuecat','customer-info'] in purchaseMutation onSuccess to make the paywall reflect PRO instantly without needing a re-navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: purchaseMutation.mutationFn does not seed/invalidate the customerInfo query on success, so on web (where addCustomerInfoUpdateListener doesn't fire after Purchases.purchasePackage) the paywall stays on the buy-button UI immediately after a successful test-store purchase. Entitlement IS applied — Profile 'PRO' label and Friends golden badge update — but paywall-active card only appears after re-navigating to /paywall. Fix: on purchaseMutation onSuccess call queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) (mirrors the successful pattern used for logIn in _layout.tsx). Reference: revenuecat.tsx:58-65.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish (LOW priority): in revenuecat.tsx purchaseMutation, add onSuccess: (customerInfo) => queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) so paywall-active card appears instantly after a successful web purchase without needing to re-navigate. Everything else is working correctly; iteration_11 blockers are resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx:57-77 — The queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) + invalidateQueries(['revenuecat']) after Purchases.logIn is the exact fix required and now works reliably in the web SDK. Consider replicating the same pattern in the purchase and restore mutations (revenuecat.tsx:58-69) so post-purchase state also propagates without waiting for the listener that does not fire on web.
paywall.tsx:26-28 — fallback to availablePackages[0] when $rc_monthly is missing is fine as a safety net, but I would add a __DEV__ warning log so pricing regressions surface immediately during dev.

revenuecat.tsx:38,45 — customer-info staleTime is 60s, offerings staleTime is 300s; on web the customerInfoUpdateListener does not fire post-purchase, so without invalidation on purchase mutation success the user could sit on the paywall for up to 60s before the UI reflects PRO. Seeding via setQueryData avoids the wait entirely.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iteration_11 blockers resolved, full purchase chain + PRO badge + PRO label + restore + close + regression all PASS)

If subsequent testing needs the un-purchased state, the test-store entitlement can be reset via the RC dashboard or by switching test user id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The RC Test Store checkout renders as an in-page overlay in the SAME tab (NOT a new tab/popup) — do NOT use page.context.expect_page() with expect_page(). Just wait ~4-6s after clicking paywall-confirm-button and then click get_by_text('Test valid purchase') to complete the transaction. After purchase, the entitlement 'pro' propagates immediately to customerInfo (visible on Profile>cog>manage-pro-button as 'PRO' and on Friends leaderboard as testID leaderboard-pro-badge on the user's own row), but the paywall-active card on the /paywall route only renders after a re-navigation to /paywall — see LOW-priority bug about purchaseMutation cache invalidation. Auth: localStorage.setItem('sprout_session_token','uitest_token_123') on initial page then reload; wait ~8s for hydration + RevenueCat init. The '[RevenueCat] identity bound: ui-test-user' log now fires reliably.
rca_of_issue: Iteration_11 bug 1 (pricing $9.99 → $2.99): main agent re-created the $rc_monthly test-store product (new product_id prod6b4569c08c) at $2.99; the web SDK now returns $2.99 in offerings.current.availablePackages[$rc_monthly].product.priceString. Verified. Iteration_11 bug 2 (identityReady stuck false): main agent added the missing queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo) + invalidateQueries(['revenuecat']) call in AuthGate right after Purchases.logIn resolves (_layout.tsx:65-66). This immediately refreshes the customerInfoQuery cache so originalAppUserId is 'ui-test-user' (not $RCAnonymousID) and paywall.tsx's derived identityReady flag flips to true. Verified: aria-disabled on paywall-buy-button is None (enabled) and the 'Syncing your account… hold on a second.' warning is not rendered.
